source: Rebuilt from the coordinator thread after the untracked ledger was deleted on 2026-11-01. The owner settled each decision in that thread.

decisions.answer: A gather and an Undo may each write the session record at most twice: the close plan, then the confirmed result.
Use shorter wording.
Share the menu-button table and Items' linkedVideo.
openCardMenu carries the video ID and the gateway refuses a recycled card.
At Undo, planned tabs whose IDs no longer exist count as closed and reopen from the saved plan.
Added “$TITLE$” to queue; Added to queue; Couldn't add “$TITLE$”; Couldn't add to queue; Couldn't confirm “$TITLE$”; Couldn't confirm the add.

decisions.topic: Card menu after a failed page click
decisions.answer: Do nothing and stay kit-free.
Every card for that video shows Added within one page view.
Confirm with "Saved. Private windows don't keep your playlist choice."

decisions.topic: Refused playlist choice after a save
decisions.answer: Stay open, show the save and the refusal, keep Undo, retry only the choice.
Finish both steps for the original account while consent and account authority stay valid.

decisions.topic: Ticked Clear all under a newer layout
decisions.answer: Clear this browser only and leave synced settings for the newer version.
Cleared on this browser. Synced settings were left for the newer version of Perchling that saved them. Update Perchling here to clear them too.
Approved as drafted in 08-release.md section 10.2. The cookie bullet goes if ticket 25 finds no shipped route reads the session cookie.
Raise feature-card-menu.js from 0.5 KB to 1.25 KB gzip.
Move lastAccount out of the Device record.

decisions.topic: Native account removal and synced Setup tombstones
decisions.answer: Build both in 2.0 now.

Any browser expires a tombstone 30 days after its edit time, during an automatic receive pass with sync on, dropping its local copy and removing the synced copy in a separate cleanup turn. Filter tombstones go with their Setup's. ARC-MOD-21 gains an exception.
Replace 1.x now: the first cutover change deletes the 1.x React app and src/lib, and main ships nothing until 2.0 is usable. Activation of a release stays held.
Never ship 1.5.0. 2.0 replaces 1.4.5 directly; the interim build matters only as an upgrade source path.
Narrow to https://www.youtube.com/* on both browsers, accepting that some upgraders may need to grant access again. Amend the spec.
Change the spec to describe the per-operation owners as built, not a single Store.change() with one Change union.

No Vite+ toolchain. Stay on bun test; delete the 322 Vitest tests with 1.x. Take the measured wins: oxlint (default plus a few type-aware rules), upstream Vite 8.3.5, AGENT=0 and explicit --timeout in both Bun runners, split the heaviest store test files and shard CI. See vite-plus-research.md.
Put them in Settings > Privacy & data. The agent writes the copy with pstack unslop; no separate review round.
Pick the shortcut's playlist
Use Material Symbols, not YouTube Music's own icon paths.
Count only 2.0 code; behavior the interim build delivers stays open until 2.0 code does it.

decisions.topic: Store reviewer credentials in CI (REL-STORE-21, 24, REL-CI-46)
decisions.answer: Design it now: the agent writes the design and credential-free tests, then brings them to the owner for approval before anything runs.
decisions.landed: Owner approved the design and approval list on 2026-11-02 at 2.0/ci-reviewer-credentials-2 tip 403d3109c, after five secret-flow reviews; integrating onto compose-units. All secret-reading jobs stay off until the owner pins the actions, runs the dry run, sets up amo-reviewer and commits the turn-on.

decisions.answer: Stays off until ticket 25's live checks verify production ownership and session contracts on a real signed-in account.
Every piece of user-facing copy goes through pstack unslop.
Unslop everything, including strings the spec pins word for word; amend the spec where wording changes.
No subtitle under "Pick the shortcut's playlist".
Activate the 1.99.1 beta only once every 2.0 feature is built (plan wave 8) and the full suite plus browser builds pass.
Run ticket 25's live checks after the first beta; ship with the provisional cookie line and re-pin if it changes.
Show no check marks on YouTube Music until ticket 25's M2 check.
Treat collaborative playlists the user doesn't own as not owned until the ACC-35 check.
One oxfmt reformat commit after all area branches merge, listed in .git-blame-ignore-revs.
Reword the two colon-joined bullets through unslop and re-pin the new text as version 1 with its new digest; 2.0 hasn't shipped, so nobody agreed to the old text.
